name: @dzbot/sdk
description: Build your own DayZ Discord bot or website on dzbot: players, wallets, shop, tickets, kill feed and every other dzbot feature through one typed client, plus Sign in with dzbot, webhooks and live events.

scripts.generate: rm -rf generated && openapi-generator-cli generate -i ${API_DOCS_URL:-https://api.dzbot.de/api/docs.json} -g typescript-fetch -o generated --additional-properties=typescriptThreePlus=true,useSingleRequestParameter=true && node scripts/trim-generated.mjs
